text:
Ivy Chen: Heads up 10FinSecure POC is air-gapped. They want: delivery options, upgrade cadence for a 4-week POC, rollback story, SBOM, and a ballpark offline price.
Marco Ruiz: Delivery options: signed full bundle (tar/sha256), diffs (xdelta) for patches, or physical HDD/USB. Recommend full bundle + 1-2 delta patches for a 4-week POC.
Priya Singh: Upgrade cadence suggestion: initial full image, security delta at week 2, optional feature delta at week 3. Rollback: bundle-id pinning + A/B rootfs or redeploy previous bundle; DB migrations are the caveat (snapshot before migrate).
Marco Ruiz: Signature/verif samples to share:
```
curl -O https://artifacts.redwood.ai/bundle.tar.gz
curl -O https://artifacts.redwood.ai/bundle.tar.gz.sig
gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz
sha256sum -c bundle.sha256
```
Ivy Chen: SBOM: provide SPDX v2 document and a model metadata file (model hash + tokenizer version). Note: model weights >10GB likely need separate media.
Priya Singh: Pricing quick ballpark: POC license $7k-$12k + SE validation 2 days + courier/media $500-$4k depending on weight. Recommend quoting $12k-$18k all-in for negotiation.
Legal (Nora): Addendum items: media custody, export-control notice for model weights, and destruction certificate on POC end.
ops-bot: created checklist: [build bundle],[sign+sbom],[produce delta],[test on staging],[produce rollback doc].
Ivy Chen: Next: I'll send sample SBOM, sample delta patch, verification steps, and a short SOW draft. Marco/Priya: please draft rollback playbook and HSM key-flow notes. Meeting with customer Fri 11am.
Marco Ruiz: On it.
Priya Singh: Will draft migration guard and canary steps.
Ivy Chen: Thanks team.
